cause_quote: The new `if (!showDebugDetails && !showUpdateDiagnostics)` branch returned the generic title and help hint before the existing `Reason:` line could render the blank-agent error.
user_saw: Running `openclaw models status --agent " "` in text mode showed a generic failure and a doctor hint instead of telling the operator that `--agent` must not be blank.
summary: The fix throws an expected CLI error so the routed `models status` command displays the existing blank-agent message in text mode.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit’s parent and confirmed that the existing `models status` route passed the raw flag value to the blank-agent guard and that the root formatter printed the resulting plain error’s message in its `Reason:` line. PR #163381 added an early return for ordinary invocations that hid that message, while preserving the existing output path for expected CLI errors.
